listing.name: Street Fighter III: 3rd Strike / 3SX
listing.summary: A native Street Fighter III: 3rd Strike engine using your own PlayStation 2 data.

presentation.manual_preparation: This is the deliberately selected rolling prerelease, with upstream bugs and instability expected. Complete the normal in-process setup wizard using your legally obtained Street Fighter III: 3rd Strike or Street Fighter Anniversary Collection for PlayStation 2, or prepare the exact SF33RD.AFS from THIRD/ in the upstream resources location. A CPS-3/MAME set, future arcade-ROM-only roadmap or a different edition is not the current source contract. The selected Windows player 3sx.exe lives in bin/ and uses its executable parent as the launch working directory; keep all packaged dependencies. Normal resources, configuration, cache, logs and user storage live under AppData/Roaming/CrowdedStreet/3SX; preserve the whole actual profile and any custom effective roots. Upstream checks the expected AFS when its checksum option is enabled; Core does not authenticate, acquire, copy or import original data. Core owns engine replacement on the declared rolling provider channel; upstream owns original-data preparation and shared external profiles. Core supplies no external-profile backup, migration or deletion. Preserve the complete old runtime and compatible actual player data before changes. Rolling tag/assets can change; published provider identity and reviewed current selection remain required, and ambiguity or missing independent identity must refuse. No netplay, rollback gameplay, actual original import, save compatibility or physical-platform acceptance is claimed.
